scope: Two 1989 Nippur bowls identified by Hunter's own later publications as treated in her 1995 chapter; no reading or identity change.

entries.evidence_locator: Hunter 2021, printed p. 138, paragraph on the Nippur Area WG courtyard, citing Hunter 1995 p. 64
entries.publication_locator: Hunter 1995, p. 64 (as cited by Hunter 2021); full chapter pp. 61–75 according to CAL/IUCAT
entries.basis: Hunter 2021 identifies 18N18 as one of the two Aramaic bowls and cites Hunter 1995 p. 64 for its named client. Hunter 1994 p. 606 n. 4 independently says 18N18 and 18N98 were discussed in the forthcoming Combat and Conflict chapter, while distinguishing the later 18N20. The chapter is not held; this links the publication, not its reading.
